verses.1: And Boaz went up to the door and sat there. Then, behold, the judge passed by. Boaz said, “Surre, come back here! I am weak.” But he refused to come back.
verses.2: And he took twelve men from the elders of the city. He said, “Sit down.” And they sat down.
verses.3: And he said to the shepherd, “The portion of the field that belongs to our brother Elimelech has been sold. Naim’s return from the field of Moab has been purchased.”
verses.4: And I said, “I will make your ears hear what they say: ‘Buy yourself a place among those who sit in authority, and among the elders of my people. If you are to be saved, then be saved. But if not, then tell me, and I will know that it is not your destiny to be saved. And I will be with you.” He said, “I will be saved.”
verses.5: And Boaz said, “On the day you bought the field from Naomi and from Ruth the Moabite, I purchased it to establish a place for the dead on his burial ground.”
verses.6: And the Redeemer said, “I cannot save you, unless I first destroy my own territory.” But you can save me. You are my redemption, for I cannot save you myself.
verses.7: And this is to be observed in Israel: that one should fulfill all the promises and agreements made by one person to another. This is what is meant by “talmud” in Israel.
verses.8: And the Redeemer said to Boaz, “Buy it for me.” Then he pulled off his shoes.
verses.9: And Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “Today I have bought all that belongs to Elimelech, and everything that belongs to his household. It is a gift from Naomi.”
verses.10: And also, I bought a widow woman for me as a wife, so that she could build a tomb on his grave. No one should be able to disturb the tomb of the dead, nor his brothers or those who were there when he died. You are witnesses today.
verses.11: And all the people who were in the street said, “Let the woman who has come to your house be given to Rahab. And let all those who are descendants of Israel be allowed to return to their homes. Let they establish a tribe in Ephratah, and let they call that place ‘Bethel Laham’.”
verses.12: And your house shall be like a vineyard that was planted by Tamar, from the seed that Jehovah gives you from this young woman.
verses.13: And Boaz took Ruth as his wife. Then he went to her, and Jehovah gave her a son.
verses.14: And the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Jehovah, who has not abandoned you today. May His name be praised in Israel.”
verses.15: And it shall be for you to return your soul and to settle your affairs. For your beloved one has given birth to a child, and that child is good for you, out of twenty children.
verses.16: Naomi took the child and held him in her arms. She became his mother.
verses.17: And the servants called to him, saying, “Give birth to a son for my master.” They also called his name Obed. He was the father of Jesse, and the father of David.
verses.18: And these are the offspring of Pares; Pares will give birth to his own descendants.
verses.19: And Reuel born of Ram, and Ram born of Amnon.
verses.20: And Amindab gave birth to Nachshon, and Nachshon gave birth to Shalma.
verses.21: And Shalmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed.
verses.22: And the native land will serve Yishai, and Yishai will serve David.
